messages:
Samir (oncall): FWIW p95 latency jumped to ~820ms on ingest-service around 16:42 UTC. Autoscaler started thrashing. I opened a hotfix PR to revert the 11/12 change to batch-scheduler. PTAL asap: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123

deploy-bot: Alert: CPU spike on ingest-service from 16:42 to 16:48. Incident created: #INC-2025-334

Jessica: :eyes: looking now. can you paste the PR diff?

Samir (oncall): diff snippet:
```diff
- use_old_batch_scheduler = false
+ use_old_batch_scheduler = true
```
I also pushed a rollback branch `hotfix/revert-batch-scheduler-4123`.

Liam: re-running the smoke tests locally, will post results. If CI passes, I can approve.

Olga: Does the revert impact KV caching behavior? If so we should toggle feature flag instead of full revert.

Samir (oncall): good Q. This change only touches scheduling decision logic, KV cache untouched. Confirmed by perf run. Opting for revert for speed.

Jessica: ok running integration test. If green, I'll merge. Timeout window?

Samir (oncall): need merge within 15m to stop the autoscaler churn. I'm monitoring.

Liam: local smoke ✅ no failures. unit tests flaky but passing locally.

Jessica: CI green ✅ build 5678. tagging @Liam @Olga for approvals

Liam: :thumbsup: Approving now. @Samir you want me to merge or you handle? can't do force push

Samir (oncall): Please merge when ready. Use `gh pr merge --squash` and select 'Create merge commit' (we prefer squash for hotfixes).

Jessica: merged and deployed. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123/merge :shipit:

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded to prod-1 in 2m30s. Latency returning to baseline.

Samir (oncall): monitoring p95: 180ms -> back to normal. thanks all. I'll follow up in incident doc.
